projectDescription: A ready-to-use collection of specialized AI coding agents, skills, and configuration for the opencode platform — covering web, game development, system programming, and automated project documentation.
keyFeatures: Orchestrator agent that routes tasks to the right specialist automatically
Domain-specific coding agents for Rust, C#, Web, FiveM, Discord, Unity, and Godot
Planning agent for structured feature breakdown before implementation
Code review agent for correctness, security, and regression checks
Research agents for grounding implementation in accurate, current documentation
Reusable skills for OpenCode configuration, UI design, and Unity CLI workflows
GitHub Project Docs CLI tool for generating repository documentation automatically
MCP integration support (e.g., Godot via ziva-local bridge)
publicApiSurface: agents/orchestrator — primary agent: routes tasks to specialists
agents/planner — breaks features into ordered, testable task lists
agents/dev — general implementation agent
agents/csharp — C# / .NET / ASP.NET specialist
agents/rust — Rust / Cargo / async specialist
agents/webdev — React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, full-stack web specialist
agents/fivem — FiveM Lua / ESX / QBCore specialist
agents/discord — Discord bot and Cloudflare Workers specialist
agents/unity — Unity gameplay, rendering, DOTS/ECS specialist
agents/godot — Godot 4 GDScript and C# specialist
agents/researcher — external API and documentation research specialist
agents/code-researcher — code-grounded technical research specialist
agents/code-reviewer — post-implementation review agent
agents/tester — test writing and execution agent
agents/opencode — OpenCode configuration specialist
skills/customize-opencode — safe OpenCode config modification skill
skills/awesome-design-md — UI/design reference skill
skills/unity-cli-helper — Unity CLI and Editor automation skill
bin/github-project-docs.js --repo OWNER/REPO [--ref REF] [--output FILE] [--include-source] [--max-source-lines N]
